# Workflow: audit only, do not edit

1. Request source deck only if it is absent and task is impossible; otherwise review available slides or screenshots.
2. Capture existing target audience, slide type and constraints from provided material.
3. Diagnose per-slide and deck-wide issues from `references/anti-slop-audit.md`.
4. Rank defects **BLOCKER / MAJOR / MINOR** based on evidence, comprehension and usability impact.
5. Provide exact fixes, not "make it modern": e.g., "replace three disconnected icons on slide 7 with a 4-stage flow using the original data".
6. Recommend one primary style and define why it fits. Note positive choices worth retaining.
7. Do not create or modify any content unless user subsequently requests it.
